findings.issue: The comment 'An out already seen is not counted' labels outs('9c 8d', '7h 6s Tc'), but that hand is a made straight (6-7-8-9-T); it returns [] because of the hasStraight guard, not the seen-card filter. It duplicates the made-straight case below and misleads a reader about what is covered.
findings.evidence: 9c 8d + 7h 6s Tc = 6789T straight; for an open-ended window, a completing rank already present always means a made straight, so this case can never test the seen filter.
findings.fix: Drop the line and its comment, or move it under 'counts no outs for a made draw' with a matching comment.

findings.issue: openEnderStart treats a hole card as part of the run when its rank merely duplicates a board rank. For example, hero 7c 2d on board 5h 6s 7h 8d gets 8 straight outs even though the four-straight is entirely on the board and any 4 or 9 also gives every opponent a straight. This follows the spec's literal wording ('a hole rank in it') and the existing hasOpenEnder definition, so it is not a spec violation, but it can produce implied-odds calls with a board-only straight draw. The flush half explicitly excludes board-only draws.
findings.evidence: fromHole = rankMask(hole) includes rank 7; present & 0b1111<<3 === run and (fromHole & run) !== 0, so v = 3 is returned and the 4s and 9s are added.
findings.fix: Optional, needs a spec or follow-up decision: require a hole rank in the run that is not also on the board (fromHole & ~rankMask(board) & run). Do this only in drawOuts so that classifyCombo stays unchanged, and add a unit case. Otherwise record it as a follow-up.

findings.issue: The value-raise example still says a capped hand 'is called or folded by the pot-odds rules below'; the implied-odds rule can now decide it too.
findings.evidence: Rule order is now pot-odds-call, then implied-odds-call, then pot-odds-fold.
findings.fix: Change to 'by the call and fold rules below'.

summary: The implementation matches the spec. drawOuts counts a flush draw only with exactly 4 of a suit and at least one hole card of it, so a made flush or a board-only four-flush gives no outs. The open-ended draw shares openEnderStart with hasOpenEnder; the wheel and broadway edges are right, and A234/JQKA are excluded. A made straight drops only the straight outs. The union is deduplicated and sorted, and the river returns []. The implied price is call/(pot incl. bet + call + bigBet x live non-all-in opponents), guarded by owed>0, outs, payers>0 and chips behind. Rule order is value, then pot-odds-call, then implied-odds-call, then fold, comparing rounded toPct values like pot-odds-call does. The hasOpenEnder refactor leaves its behaviour identical. Both locked re-pins keep every assertion: the TASK-7.3 AC#2 hero swap to Ad5c removes the draw so the fold meaning holds, and the TASK-7.8 oracle mirrors the new branch. The grade.test stub at 0.08 gives 8.0 < 8.3 implied, a fold with margin 8.7, still minor. Tests would catch breaking each guard: exactly-4, the hole-card requirement, the made-straight check, the wheel, payers counting all-ins, the hero all-in case and the opponent multiplier. tests/advice: 28 files and 168 tests pass. No BLOCKER or MAJOR findings.
